title: Highlights of Vietnam | Group Tour Package
highlights: Join an exciting group tour across Vietnam with tailor-made experiences & personal guide to assist you throughout.
Learn about the history as you explore the Cu Chi Tunnels, an underground network used during the Vietnam War.
Ride a cable car to Ba Na Hills, visit the famous Golden Hands Bridge, and explore the charming French Village.
Visit Ninh Binh, often called "Halong Bay on Land," and explore the beautiful Trang An Grottoes by boat.
Set sail on the emerald waters of Halong Bay, surrounded by thousands of limestone karsts and mystical caves.
inclusions: Transfer from Tan Son Nhat International Airport to Deluxe Hotel
2 nights stay in Ho Chi Minh with breakfast
Half-Day Ho Chi Minh Sightseeing Tour
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Tan Son Nhat International Airport
Transfer from Da Nang International Airport to Deluxe Hotel
1 night stay in Da Nang with breakfast
Boat ride in Thu Bon River
Ba na Hills & Golden Hands Bridge Tour
Transfer from Ba na Hills & Golden Hands Bridge Tour to Da Nang International Airport
Transfer from Noi Bai International Airport to Deluxe Hotel
3 nights stay in Hanoi with breakfast
Day cruise tour in Halong bay
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Noi Bai International Airport
Accommodation on Double Sharing/ Triple Sharing Basis
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: All visitors are required to carry valid ID proof.
Rooms will be provided in a double and triple sharing basis. If any person wants a room on a single sharing basis then it can be arranged at an additional cost.
Fixed transfer time slots for Airport Pickup is 8 AM to 11 AM.
Fixed transfer time slots for Airport Drop is 12 PM to 2 PM.
Kindly note that personal expenses are not included in the package and should be budgeted separately.
Group size of the tour could be minimum 2 pax and maximum 18 pax.
Accommodations will be provided in a standard hotel within the standard room category.

Travelers are advised to book flights according to suggested timings. If the flight arrival time deviates from the schedule and the airport pick-up is missed, the traveler must arrange transfers independently.
3 Dollars tip mandatory per tour per person
If a traveler misses any activity on the arrival or departure day due to flight timings, we will not be held liable for compensation.
All reservations must be made at least 7 days prior to the scheduled date of travel.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.desc: Upon arriving at Ho Chi Minh Airport, get transferred to the hotel and check-in. Later in the evening, you can explore the lively nightlife of Ho Chi Minh City on Bui Vien Street. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Ho Chi Minh City.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh Sightseeing Tour & Cu Chi Tunnels
days.desc: Get transferred to the Independence Palace, Notre Dame Cathedral, and more attractions for your  Ho Chi Minh city tour. Later, visit Cu Chi Tunnels to learn about wartime survival. Get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Half-Day Ho Chi Minh Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Start the tour with the Independence Palace, which was once home to the President of Vietnam.
Explore the War Remnants Museum and see various weapons and documents related to the war.
Visit the Notre Dame Cathedral and Old Post Office and appreciate these architectural wonders.
Travel to Jade Emperor Pagoda, a temple designed in the traditional Chinese way.

items.title: Transfer in Coach
items.desc: Coach or similar will be Provided

items.title: Cu Chi tunnels Tour
items.desc:
Explore Cu Chi Tunnels, an underground network used as living quarters, storage, and hiding places during the Vietnam-American War.
Before exploring the tunnels, you will have a short introduction followed by an introductory video about how the tunnels were constructed and how the people survived in the harsh conditions of wartime.
Discover the resourcefulness of Vietnamese soldiers as you navigate the secret tunnels and trap systems.
Gain a deep understanding of the challenges and triumphs faced by the Vietnamese people during the war era.

days.title: Flight to Da Nang | Walking Tour of Hoi An & Boat Ride
days.desc: Check out and get transferred to the Ho Chi Minh Airport for a flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival, check in to the hotel. In the evening, enjoy a walking tour of Hoi An and visit famous attractions followed by a boat ride at Thu Bon River. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Coach
items.desc: Coach or similar will be Provided

items.desc: Coach or similar will be Provided

items.title: Walking Tour of Hoi An
items.desc:
Start your trip at the famous Japanese Covered Bridge Pagoda. It's a symbol of Hoi An, and you'll be amazed by its detailed design.
Learn about Hoi An's old Cham culture at the Sa Huynh Museum, where you can see ancient artifacts.
Next, visit the beautiful Phuoc Kien Assembly Hall. It has stunning architecture with fancy carvings and sculptures.
Watch skilled artisans creating textiles and crafts at The Silkworm and Handicraft Workshop. You might find a special souvenir to take home.
Experience everyday life at the Central Market and enjoy the local atmosphere.

items.title: Boat ride in Thu Bon River
items.desc:
After the walking tour, enjoy a boat ride on Thu Bon River.
The Thu Bon River goes from Ngoc Linh Mountain to the South China Sea, and it played a big role in making Hoi An an important place for trade.
Drifting along the Thu Bon River, you'll be enchanted by the picturesque scenes of ancient bridges and lantern-lit streets reflecting in the calm waters.
Take a journey through time, where the river's history and the vibrant culture of Hoi An come to life with every ripple.

days.title: Ba na Hills & Golden Hands Bridge Tour | Flight to Hanoi
days.desc: Get transferred to Suoi Mo Station to board a cable car and visit Golden Hand Bridge, Le Jardin D’Amour, Lady Buddha Statue, and more. Later, get transferred to the Da Nang airport for a flight to Hanoi (flight tickets included). Upon arrival, check-in to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Coach
items.desc: Coach or similar will be Provided

items.title: Ba na Hills & Golden Hands Bridge Tour
items.desc:
Enjoy a scenic cable car ride from Suoi Mo Station to Marseille Station.
Walk through the iconic Golden Hands Bridge renowned for scenes in “Game of Thrones” and "The Lords of the Rings”.
Visit Le Jardin D’Amour, a garden of 9 sections each with unique stories and designs, creating a harmonious and beautiful experience.
Visit the statue of Linh Ung Pagoda housing a Lady Buddha.

days.title: Excursion to Ninh Binh
days.desc: Get transferred to Hao Lu temples followed by a scenic boat ride to Tam Coc to explore its beautiful caves during a day trip to Ninh Binh. Later, take a bike ride through the villages to Bich Dong Pagodas. After the tour, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Coach
items.desc: Coach or similar will be Provided

items.title: Ninh Binh Tour
items.desc:
Begin your tour at Hao Lu, the historic capital of Vietnam, and witness the remnants at the ancient temples of Le and Dinh Dynasties.
Explore the well-preserved architecture and cultural significance of the temples, which date back to the 10th and 11th centuries.
Go on a boat ride from Hao Lu to Tam Coc, known as "Halong Bay on Land," renowned for its karst landscapes and lush rice fields.
Go into the stunning limestone caves of Tam Coc, formed over thousands of years by natural erosion, and marvel at their impressive stalactites and stalagmites.
Cycle on peaceful roads through the rustic Vietnamese villages and rocky formations while heading to Bich Dong, a complex of pagodas nestled among scenic surroundings.

items.title: Transfer in Coach
items.desc: Coach or similar will be Provided

days.title: Halong Harmony Day Cruise
days.desc: Get transferred to Tuan Chau Harbor in Halong Bay to board a cruise to Sung Sot Grotto, Luon Cave & Titop Island. After the cruise ride, get transferred back to the hotel in Hanoi for an overnight stay. Later, you can visit the party street of Hanoi, Beer Street.

items.title: Transfer in Coach
items.desc: Coach or similar will be Provided

items.title: Day cruise tour in Halong bay
items.desc:
Head to Tuan Chau Harbor to board the Cruise and relish on a traditional Vietnamese seafood lunch while cruising past remarkable rock formations.
The cruise will approach Sung Sot Grotto, and a small passenger boat will transfer you to the caves.
Go to Luon Cave for a unique experience as you can paddle through its waters on kayaks and bamboo boats, surrounded by towering limestone cliffs.
Enjoy Titop Island's refreshing waters with a refreshing swim & trek to the peak for breathtaking panoramic views.

items.title: Transfer in Coach
items.desc: Coach or similar will be Provided

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Pack your bags and check out from your hotel in Hanoi. Get transferred to the Hanoi Airport to board a flight back home.
